why: The plausible-looking wrong fix, and the one the shipped stylesheet's own comment warns against: `.hud-capacity` rests at `opacity: 0`, so cancelling its animation does not calm the blocked-fire cue -- it DELETES it. A player with reduced motion would simply never learn why their shot was refused. Reads as a tidier rule than the motionless keyframe set it replaces, which is what makes it the likely edit. Killed by the never-answers-by-cancelling case, which is written about the two cues that rest invisible rather than about this one line.
